evals.expected_output: The design identifies a pure pricing/state-transition core, an application shell, an application-owned storage port only if needed, a Postgres adapter, a composition root, and tests at domain and use-case seams without framework leakage.

evals.prompt: Add a pure temperature conversion helper to a small JavaScript CLI configured with the simple style.
